title: Counit-normalized comparison of the ordinary scalar models
statement: For a prime $\ell$, finite coefficient fields $E,L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an embedding $\iota:E\to L$ and an arbitrary scheme $X$, there exist a natural isomorphism t from integralOrdinaryScalar to completedOrdinaryScalarExtension [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] and a natural isomorphism e between their derived models, with these properties. The sheaf map t sends every integralOrdinaryTensorSection(s,x) to completedScalarTensorSection(s,x). On every complex P, e at Q(P), followed by the universal completedScalarCounit, equals the exact-derived factorization comparison followed by Q of the termwise t. Finally, e followed by completedScalarComparison is exactly scalarCompletion [lem-weil-normalized-scalar-completion]. No completeness assumption on P or X is imposed.

proof.text: Use ordinaryScalarModelIso from the existing scalar-constructibility construction and the universal cochain counit of completedScalarCochainModel. The left-derived universal property gives the counit-normalized natural isomorphism from integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar to completedDerivedScalarExtension. The normalized descent of the quotient-completion chain map, including its zero shifted coordinate, identifies its composite with completedScalarComparison with the actual scalarCompletion. No scheme pullback is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarOrdinaryModelComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ (t : integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X ≅
          completedOrdinaryScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X)
      (e : integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X ≅
          completedDerivedScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X),
      (∀ (N : integralTowerModules l E X) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj U)
        (x : N.val.obj U),
        (t.hom.app N).val.app U (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X N U s x) =
          completedScalarTensorSection.{u, u} l E L ι X N U s x) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ,
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ completedScalarCounit.{u, u} l E L ι X P =
          (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex t (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)) ∧
      (e.hom ≫ completedScalarComparison.{u, u} l E L ι X =
        scalarCompletion l E L ι X)
